"""Backend API tests — core run and participant flows.

Exercises create, list, detail, join, duplicate-reject, leave,
leave-not-found, and unknown-id paths against the FastAPI app via
the scaffold-provided ``client`` fixture (see root ``conftest.py``).
"""


def _create_run(client, **overrides):
    """Helper: POST a valid run and return the parsed 201 body."""
    payload = {
        "title": "Morning 5K",
        "datetime": "2025-01-15T07:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Riverside Park",
        "distance": "5K",
        "pace_target": "9:00/mi",
        "route_notes": "Steady climb on the east loop",
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    resp = client.post("/runs", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    return resp.json()


def test_create_run_success(client):
    """POST /runs with a valid payload returns 201 and a generated string id."""
    body = _create_run(client)

    # id is a non-empty generated string
    assert isinstance(body["id"], str)
    assert len(body["id"]) > 0

    # required fields are strings
    assert isinstance(body["title"], str)
    assert body["title"] == "Morning 5K"
    assert isinstance(body["datetime"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["meeting_location"], str)

    # optional fields (provided here) are strings
    assert isinstance(body["distance"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["pace_target"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["route_notes"], str)

    # participants starts as an empty list
    assert isinstance(body["participants"], list)
    assert body["participants"] == []


def test_create_run_missing_required(client):
    """POST /runs with an empty title returns 422 validation_error."""
    resp = client.post(
        "/runs",
        json={
            "title": "",
            "datetime": "2025-01-15T07:00:00",
            "meeting_location": "Park",
        },
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    envelope = resp.json()
    assert envelope["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"
    assert isinstance(envelope["error"]["message"], str)


def test_list_runs(client):
    """GET /runs returns a list containing the created run with participant info."""
    created = _create_run(client)

    resp = client.get("/runs")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    runs = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(runs, list)
    assert len(runs) == 1

    found = runs[0]
    assert found["id"] == created["id"]
    assert isinstance(found["title"], str)
    assert isinstance(found["datetime"], str)
    assert isinstance(found["meeting_location"], str)
    assert isinstance(found["participants"], list)
    assert len(found["participants"]) == 0


def test_run_detail(client):
    """GET /runs/{run_id} returns the run with all its fields intact."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    resp = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()

    assert body["id"] == run_id
    assert isinstance(body["title"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["datetime"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["meeting_location"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["distance"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["pace_target"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["route_notes"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["participants"], list)
    assert body["title"] == "Morning 5K"


def test_join_run(client):
    """POST /runs/{run_id}/join adds a participant; count increments to 1."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]
    assert len(created["participants"]) == 0

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Alice"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(body["participants"], list)
    assert "Alice" in body["participants"]
    assert len(body["participants"]) == 1


def test_join_duplicate_rejected(client):
    """A second join with the same name returns 409 duplicate_participant."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    first = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert first.status_code == 200

    second = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert second.status_code == 409
    envelope = second.json()
    assert envelope["error"]["code"] == "duplicate_participant"
    assert isinstance(envelope["error"]["message"], str)


def test_leave_run(client):
    """Join then leave: participant is removed and count returns to 0."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    join_resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Carol"})
    assert join_resp.status_code == 200
    assert len(join_resp.json()["participants"]) == 1

    leave_resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Carol"})
    assert leave_resp.status_code == 200
    body = leave_resp.json()
    assert isinstance(body["participants"], list)
    assert "Carol" not in body["participants"]
    assert len(body["participants"]) == 0


def test_leave_nonexistent(client):
    """Leave with a name not on the run returns 404 participant_not_found."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Ghost"})
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    envelope = resp.json()
    assert envelope["error"]["code"] == "participant_not_found"
    assert isinstance(envelope["error"]["message"], str)


def test_unknown_run_id(client):
    """GET /runs/nonexistent returns 404 run_not_found."""
    resp = client.get("/runs/nonexistent")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    envelope = resp.json()
    assert envelope["error"]["code"] == "run_not_found"
    assert isinstance(envelope["error"]["message"], str)
